name: Mindwhisker
description: At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. Threshold -- As long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, creatures your opponents control get -1/-0.
couldNotDerive: The specific phase (Phase$Upkeep -> generic 'phase' trigger-type, same known gap as Innkeeper's Talent/Star Charter).
notes: Found and fixed a real, more serious bug: the S: static handler's AddPower/AddToughness/AddKeyword/AddType/GainControl branches ALL hardcoded owner:'me' regardless of Affected$'s own qualifiers -- this card's real 'creatures YOUR OPPONENTS control get -1/-0' rendered as if it affected the caster's own creatures, a meaningfully wrong fact, not just an imprecision. Fixed by computing owner per Affected$ clause (flips to 'opp' only on an explicit .OppCtrl/.OppOwn/.Opponent qualifier, defaulting to 'me' otherwise to preserve the common lord-effect shape). Also added the new Condition$Threshold fix. Verified: node F now shows owner:opp and cond:threshold.
